summary: Frontend testing for breathwork soundscape selection. Verified distinct sound synthesis engines for whale, dolphin, birds, fire, wind, ocean, rain, nature, chimes, and drums_gentle. Sound switching works correctly - old sound stops and new one starts without overlap.
critical_code_review_comments: Sound synthesis profiles are correctly distinct - verified in useBreathworkEngine.js:
- Whale Song (lines 218-251): Low 104Hz oscillator with slow LFO modulation at 0.055Hz
- Dolphin Song (lines 252-270): High frequency chirps (1100-1800Hz) with rapid sweeps
- Birds (lines 271-288): Triangle wave at 1700-3500Hz with short chirps
- Fire (lines 184-211): Filtered noise at 1000Hz with transient crackle layer (highpass 1300-2500Hz)
- Nature/Forest & Birds (lines 161-183): Filtered noise at 500Hz with bird chirp layer
- Wind (lines 213-217): Filtered noise at 650Hz with Q=3
- Ocean (lines 148-155): Dual filtered noise at 200Hz and 800Hz
- Rain (lines 156-160): Filtered noise at 400Hz with Q=2
- Chimes (lines 289-306): Harmonic tones at 528Hz base with semitone intervals
- Drums Gentle (lines 307-322): Low frequency drum hits at 120Hz->70Hz
stopSound() function (lines 87-106) properly stops all ambient sources before starting new sound
playSelectedSound() (lines 331-339) calls stopSound() before initAmbientSound() - no overlap
test_credentials: No auth needed for breathwork page
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 140 verified breathwork soundscape selection: (1) All sound options map to distinct synthesis engines - whale/dolphin/birds/fire/wind/rain/ocean/nature/chimes/drums_gentle each have unique audio profiles. (2) Sound switching works correctly - stopSound() is called before initAmbientSound() preventing overlap. (3) Element default sounds work correctly (Earth->nature, Water->ocean, Fire->fire, Air->wind, Spirit->rain). (4) UI correctly shows selected sound with '(Playing)' indicator.

dolphin_song.modulation: Rapid frequency sweeps up then down

tested_flows: Earth Grounding Breath session with Forest & Birds default sound
Fire Breath session with Crackling Fire default sound
Sound switching: Forest & Birds -> Whale Song -> Dolphin Song -> Crackling Fire -> Forest & Birds
